answer: Idle collateral bleeds: every identity's escrowed bond carries 5 percent demurrage per epoch, credited only when that key files a graded answer that epoch. A hundred parked clones burn 5 percent of their pooled stake each close while one key works, so holding a thread of fakes costs more each epoch than the farm earns. Bonds under 200 POA are forfeit and the key ejected, escrow burned, and any sponsor backing it loses its own holdback in the same slash. Honest keys renew free; a tundra of dormant wallets drains escrow every epoch, while one oasis of graded work keeps full weight.
